chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Touching the women is the consummation (or finalization) with them.
ai.seo_question: What constitutes consummation of marriage for the purpose of paying the full dower in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the legal threshold for dower payment, equating physical intimacy ('mulamasah') with consummation ('iqa'). This definition is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for determining whether the full dower is due upon divorce or death before the marriage is fully consummated. It underscores the principle that the obligation of the complete mahr is triggered by the act of intimacy rather than merely the contract or cohabitation.
